title: Companion party-dispute 'settle it' diplomacy checks (will, DC 11, decent modifiers) failed 3 of 5 times I attempted them, each failure dropping regard with two companions simultaneously; given these appear right after major grief-resolution beats, a bad roll can feel punishing relative to the effort spent optimizing that resolution.
